A first stop before [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Prophet-6 is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **Prophet-6** was released by Sequential (then called Dave Smith Instruments) in **2015** (Wikipedia, "Sequential (company)").
- It has **six voices** (Prophet-6 Operation Manual, p. 1). It is a modern relative of the [Prophet-5](intro-prophet-5.qmd).

## Its sound

- Each oscillator's **shape** turns smoothly from triangle to saw to pulse (manual, pp. 15-17).
- A **sub-octave** sits one octave below oscillator 1 (manual, p. 19).
- It has two filters: a 4-pole **low-pass** and a 2-pole **high-pass** (manual, pp. 20-23).
- Two **digital effects** in a row: chorus, phaser, delay and reverbs (manual, pp. 26-28); also an analog **distortion** (p. 41).

## Guided tour

Each step loads a worked example (recipes from the Prophet-6 manual) and changes one thing.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-pad-fx" data-set="{&quot;fxOn&quot;:false}"><p><b>A pulse pad, dry.</b> Effects off. Listen: a plain, moving pad.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-pad-fx"><p><b>Effects on.</b> Chorus in slot A, hall reverb in slot B. Listen: wide and far away.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-sync"><p><b>Sync and Poly Mod.</b> The filter envelope sweeps oscillator 1's pitch. Listen for a tearing lead.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-gated"><p><b>LFO on the loudness.</b> A square LFO turns the sound on and off. Listen: a chopped organ.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-unison" data-set="{&quot;dist&quot;:0}"><p><b>Unison bass.</b> All six voices on one note, no distortion. Listen: thick.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="p6-unison"><p><b>Add distortion.</b> Distortion at 3. Listen: grittier.</p></div>
```

**For students**

Sequential. *Prophet-6 Operation Manual*. Version 1.0, Dave Smith Instruments, June 2015, [analoguehaven.com/sequential/prophet-6/manual.pdf](https://analoguehaven.com/sequential/prophet-6/manual.pdf). Printed page = PDF page - 10. Six voices; oscillators with continuously variable shape, sync, low freq (pp. 15-17); slop (p. 18); mixer and triangle sub octave (p. 19); 4-pole LP and 2-pole HP (pp. 20-23); envelopes (pp. 22-26); two effect slots and their types (pp. 26-28); LFO (pp. 31-33); Poly Mod (pp. 33-34); distortion (p. 41); unison (p. 43). Its recipes are the page's Prophet-6 examples. Faithful panel (panels/p6.js): measured off the Prophet-6 front panel drawing, printed p. 1 (PDF p. 11).
:::
